## `ProjectPI`

*Available in [R](#projectpi-r)*
=== "R"
    !!! bug "Deprecated Function"
        This function has been deprecated, and will be removed in a future CIDAtools release.
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function returns the PI Name or blank if none exists.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    ProjectPI()

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>
    *No arguments*
    <h4>Returns</h4>

    A character string with the PI name
